description: Updatr catalog: debloat items (ads, junk, privacy) and the Store apps never to flag.

items.description: One debloat item: a named, revertible set of changes.

id.description: Unique id: lowercase letters/digits joined by single hyphens. Shown in the CLI and kept in history - do not rename.

group.description: recommended (applied by default) or optional (only when picked).

category.description: Heading it is listed under, e.g. "Ads and suggestions".

title.description: Short name shown in the list.

description.description: What it changes and why, in a sentence or two.

warning.description: Shown before applying when the change has a cost ("Game Pass needs the Xbox app").

minBuild.description: Lowest Windows build it applies to (22000 = Windows 11). Omit for every supported build.

actions.description: The changes, applied in order and reverted in reverse.

anyOf.description: Set or remove one registry value. Set exactly one of dword, string, or delete.

key.description: Key path under the hive, e.g. Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo.

dword.description: Set a REG_DWORD to this number.

string.description: Set a REG_SZ to this text.

delete.description: Remove the value instead of setting it.

anyOf.description: Remove a Microsoft Store (Appx) app for the current user, and from the image so new users do not get it.

name.description: Package name wildcard (* and ?), e.g. Microsoft.BingNews or king.com.*. Case-insensitive.

storeId.description: Microsoft Store product id used to reinstall it on revert, e.g. 9WZDNCRFHVFW. Omit when the Store no longer offers it.

keepProvisioned.description: Leave it in the Windows image, so only the current user loses it (skips the administrator step).

anyOf.description: Change a Windows service's start type (and stop it when disabling). Needs administrator access.

name.description: Service name (not the display name), e.g. DiagTrack.

anyOf.description: Disable a scheduled task. Needs administrator access.

keep.description: Store app package names (wildcards) that are wanted or part of Windows, so never listed as unrecognized.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this file's JSON schema. Ignored by Updatr.

schemaVersion.description: Catalog schema version. Updatr ignores a catalog newer than it understands and falls back to its cached or built-in copy.
